rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard is finished. I've chosen a handle-free design.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I open it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: By appreciating the uninterrupted surface first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It won't open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the storage is exceptionally secure.

card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The report's complete apart from the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The numbers are the report.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I've finished its supporting structure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's just a title page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A clear vision. Most reports lack one.

card.title: I’ve Done This Before
card.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

card.title: I’ve Done This Before
card.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

card.title: Outdo the Effort
card.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

card.title: Outdo the Effort
card.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

card.title: Efficiency Win
card.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live eight floors up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A full programme included in the rent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do we carry the shopping?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Resistance training. We've saved two memberships.

card.title: Efficiency Win
card.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

card.title: No Trouble at All
card.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't eaten either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

card.title: No Trouble at All
card.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

card.title: Fair Exchange
card.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash up if you do two shopping trips.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two trips for one pan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This pan has dried cheese. Rates have changed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll soak it first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one trip and the detergent.

card.title: Fair Exchange
card.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thirty minutes helping you move buys me Saturday morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only free morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand the value of my thirty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I pay cash?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough to buy back a Saturday. Let's calculate.

card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant all twenty boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I watered the plant you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant on the windowsill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll water those too. That covers the windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every day until I get back, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll give each one a teaspoon daily. You specified the frequency, so I'll be exact about that.

card.title: One Thing Leads to Another
card.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This dripping tap is our chance to replace the whole sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only needs a washer. I've bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We'll fit it while the sink's out and replace that swollen worktop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll empty the kitchen. With the cupboards out, we can finally fix the layout.

card.title: One Thing Leads to Another
card.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're opening in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll sell the tickets; I'll decide when we draw. One clear chain of command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticket queue is already round the hall. Come help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll stand beside you and authorise extra ticket sellers. You can start recruiting them.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't equal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.

card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shift ends at five. Your dismissal is still pending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's five fifteen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You've demonstrated punctual attendance at the dismissal review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to approve your change of location.

card.title: Not Dismissed
card.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Wear this deputy badge and help me decide who gets a hall key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Deputy to the caretaker?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until the elected committee learns which doors I've opened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not call me co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because the spare keys still answer to my pocket.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The modest caretaker controls access and uses it to recruit a subordinate, not an equal; B's cooperation reveals who directs the work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't mind me, I merely keep the concert lights working. You can be my assistant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The conductor asked me to help them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Tell them our lighting schedule is final.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whose schedule?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ours, in the sense that you'll deliver the one I chose.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The modest caretaker controls access and uses it to recruit a subordinate, not an equal; B's cooperation reveals who directs the work.

card.title: Hidden Power
card.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only the caretaker. Plan whatever concert you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll start at eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I unlock the hall at nine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we have a key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Submit your preferred concert time to me.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I need help, not a second direction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does the deputy do?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everything I can confidently delegate.

card.title: Hidden Power
card.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't put me on the committee. I only send the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've voted to invite the whole street.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How lovely. I'll send them to the six people I have addresses for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give you the full address list tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Just mark which six you'd most like me to find stamps for.

card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't equal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.
